aliases.name: FHU-BPAD-2U-5
aliases.note: the five-pack of this panel (datasheet, QSG note 1)

physical.fixing: tool-less, E-shape clips push into the rail holes; snaps apart into 1U strips

base.description: One FHU-BPAD-2U panel as FS ships it, whole.

description: 2U 19in tool-less ABS blanking panel, FS FHU-BPAD-2U: one black moulded plate 88 x 482.6 mm, scored into 1U strips that snap apart, with a straight and a wave rib across the back of each unit and an E-shaped clip at each end that pushes into the rail holes. Also sold as the five-pack FHU-BPAD-2U-5.

gaps.note: the wave rib's amplitude and period are read off an angled render, not dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: a square-on rear photograph with a scale

ribs.description: the wave rib across the back of each unit, top unit first

name: fhu-bpad-2u

badge.note: a recessed badge near the left end of each unit carries FS's mark: 19.7 to 54.5 across and 5.1 to 14.3 down the unit on the render g2 at 2.74 px/mm. The recess is drawn; the mark in it is a logo and is not.

chassis.note: the plate is the part: "88 x 482.6 mm", one moulded ABS plate the width of the rack with its clips at the ends of its back, so the face is drawn at 482.6 (the owner's rule of 2026-10-09; lint L43 stands down for a body this wide).

clips.note: each unit carries an E-shaped ABS clip at each end of its back (render x4), whose rounded head shows past the plate's end at the middle of the unit, 23.8 tall and about 4.6 across on g2; the clip's body behind the plate and its metal pin (g3) are drawn 4 x 6 and 2 across, estimated.

color.note: black textured ABS, as the renders and "Color: Black".

depth.note: 14: FS's dimensioned render (x3) prints about 14 mm at the end of the plate, which is the plate and the ribs behind it. The 3D body is one box that deep across the full width.

lifecycle.note: checked 2026-10-09 against what the intake holds: the FS product page for this SKU was live when the intake read it on 2026-10-08, and the FS documentation portal's Accessories tree, read the same day, carries no end-of-sale notice for it. No web search beyond FS's own pages was made.

mark.note: FS's mark in each badge is a logo and is not drawn.

method.note: the FS Plastic Blanking Panel Datasheet (portal 7735), FHU-BPAD-2U and FHU-BPAD-2U-5 columns, and the product page, for the size, material and weight; the face from the FS Blanking Panel Visio stencil, master FHU-BPAD-2U, and the straight-on gallery renders of SKU 284589 (g2 front, g3 back); the depth from the dimensioned render (x3); the quick start guide (portal 7736) for the packs and the snapping apart.

packs.note: FHU-BPAD-2U-5 is five of this panel in one box (datasheet columns; QSG note 1), so it is a vendor alias and not a configuration part number: `part-numbers` carries no quantity, and a second part number on the base configuration would rename the DCIM export after the first-sorted SKU.

pin-mark.note: a small round mark in the middle of each unit's face, at 241 across and 21.7 down the unit on the front render g2 (x6 shows it close up), 7 to 8 px across at 2.74 px/mm, about 2.6 to 2.9 mm; drawn 2.7. FS does not say what it is; it reads as a moulding pin mark, not a hole.

ribs.note: the back (g3, g5) carries, per unit, a straight rib along the middle of the unit and a wave rib crossing it, from about 18 mm in from each end: the wave is drawn as a cosine of 6.5 mm amplitude and 152 mm period, lowest at 86 mm from the left end (the part fs/bpad-wave-rib@1, a stroked curve): the straight-on rear render (g3, 2.73 px/mm) has its low runs centred near 86, 247 and 390 (161 and 143 apart, so not evenly spaced) and swings about 6.5 either side of the straight rib; the cosine puts its lows at 86, 238 and 390, the middle one 9 mm left of the render's - an estimate of the shape, not a measurement of it.

sides.note: the plate's end edge-on and the ends of the ribs behind it.

units.note: the plate snaps apart into 1U strips (datasheet: "Snappable Design"; QSG: "you can manually take the blanking panels apart"); the score lines between the units are drawn at every 44 mm, the stencil's and the render's single line on the 2U.

weight.note: the datasheet: 142 g a panel, 710 g the five-pack FHU-BPAD-2U-5.
